Description: Power of Attorney information is not in QLAdmin. Examples of active policies with POAs on file in LifePRO are 9010442216, 9010451650, and 9011045619. Root cause: LifePRO RELATE_CODE=PW was passed through as quikclid.MRELATION=PW instead of POFA, AND the quikcloth (Client Other Record) table that actually backs the Names/Other Information grid was never populated.
Notes: 09/08/2026 Resolution: Power of Attorney now shows in QLAdmin's Names tab Other Information box. Fixed the relationship code mapping (quikclid) and added the missing quikcloth table that grid actually reads from, then fixed a DBF field-padding bug in the Append Tool so it matches other client ID fields. Confirmed live in QLAdmin. Examples: 9010442216C Marlys Vander Wal; 9010451650C Timothy Mountain; 9011045619C Andrew Mazzurco.
